# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_PINBAR_REVERSAL

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the EMA ribbon (8,13,21) compresses to less than 0.1% of price and a pin-bar reversal forms at the outer edge of the ribbon, the subsequent move tends to follow the pin-bar direction. This captures short-term exhaustion and re-acceleration after a period of low volatility and indecision.

## Mechanism

Compute ribbon width as (highest EMA – lowest EMA) / close on 5‑min bars. If width < 0.001 (0.1% of price) and the bar forms a pin‑bar defined as: body ≤ 0.3× total range, and the wick opposite the intended direction ≥ 0.6× total range; for bullish pin‑bar (long lower wick) enter long at the close of the bar; for bearish pin‑bar (long upper wick) enter short at the close. Exit: stop placed at the tip of the pin‑bar (extreme of the long wick); target 1:2 risk‑reward; if price reaches 1R, trail stop with a 15% trailing stop from highest close (longs) or lowest close (shorts). Regime hint: only trade when VIX < 15 to ensure ribbon compression is meaningful; avoid when VIX > 25.
